title: Localization of an exact adjunction to derived categories
statement: Let $C,D$ be abelian categories with chosen derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $F:C\to D$ and $G:D\to C$ be additive exact functors, and let $a:F\dashv G$ be their specified adjunction. Localize its degreewise cochain adjunction at quasi-isomorphisms, using the standard exact-functor factorizations, to define the specified adjunction $D(F)\dashv D(G)$. Its units and counits are the localized original units and counits.

lean.statement:
def exactDerivedAdjunction {C D : Type v} [Category.{h} C] [Category.{h} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} D]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G] (a : F ⊣ G) :
    F.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ G.mapDerivedCategory
